title: Swap the Spear Hero With a Party Member
text: “Oink.”
“So this is the room where Itsuki’s crew is, huh?”
The pig nodded. It seems about half of the guys called “Shadows” look like pigs. Or was it just a coincidence that this one happened to be a pig’s shadow?
I’m going to knock on Itsuki’s crew’s door. I’ve been through this once before, after all. Thinking back to Itsuki’s crew from that time makes me feel a little uneasy.
Well, back then I was trying to pick up an Itsuki who happened to be a pig. Other than that, I remember that Smoked Meat was loud and pushy, but I blew it to smithereens, so it’s gone now.
So, the situation is different this time. The Itsuki—who are nothing but a bunch of vain show-offs—might not be here. Is this just a rag-tag group of companions?
“Come in.”
“Alright, I’m coming in.”
I entered the room where the Itsuki were.
“Thank you for coming, Spear Hero.”
……I wonder why. This scene looks familiar—like something I saw back on Cal Mira Island. Itsuki’s crew is relaxing in whatever poses they please.
Well, obviously, Smoked Meat isn’t here. Oh? I don’t see the stalker pig either. He’s probably stalking Itsuki right now.
“I’m Motoyasu Kitamura, and starting today, I’ll be looking after you lot in Itsuki’s place for a while. We’ll be counting on you for the next couple of days.”

That’s what I said, but Itsuki’s companions seem rather unenthusiastic. Um, I think it’s the warrior—the one who acted all high and mighty right after “Smoked Meat,” who was supposed to join Itsuki’s group—who’s turning his face toward me. He’s glaring at me with a look that just doesn’t sit right. Most likely, he shares Itsuki’s view that they aren’t the bad guys.
“Yes, nice to meet you. Please watch the battle of us, Lord Itsuki’s Personal Guard, from the sidelines, Spear Hero.”
Huh? I feel like Smoked Meat said that line before. But a personal guard, huh?

Hmm… My memory of Itsuki’s group is a bit fuzzy, but I have the impression—or maybe not—that their numbers haven’t decreased. I don’t know the exact number, though. Anyway, the stalker pig isn’t here right now.
“That’s right, we are Lord Itsuki’s Five-Man Personal Guard! It’s a pleasure to meet you.”

They’re striking some kind of victory pose. I feel like I saw this last time too, but I couldn’t care less. These are the sort of people who’ll all be executed in the future. I suppose I could consider disposing of them under the pretext of an ‘accident due to negligence,’ but since I don’t know how Itsuki would react to that, I’ll put it on hold for now.
“Well then, let’s go.”
“Wait a moment!”
“…What is it?”
One of Itsuki’s warrior companions sticks his hand out in a haughty manner.
“Don’t you have any thoughts on our signature catchphrase!?”
…Is he an idiot or something? There’s no need to waste time on such nonsense.
“Well then, shall I cast an explosion Magic spell behind you just as you strike that pose? I’ll blow you all to bits. That’ll make for some spectacular fireworks.”
I’m implying that if they say anything ridiculous, I’ll wipe them out. Perhaps sensing my murderous intent, the warrior fell silent for a moment.
“A-all right. Let’s just assume the Spear Hero doesn’t understand our sense of aesthetics and cut him some slack.”
It annoyed me, but I’ll just ignore them. These guys are only motivated by their own self-satisfaction anyway.
“Come to think of it, that pig who’s been stalking Itsuki isn’t here.”
As I scanned the area, a pig—or what appeared to be a shadow—appeared and was saying something to Itsuki’s companions.

“The one who isn’t here right now… are you talking about Rishia? She was taken back home because her parents got worried during this commotion. She swore she’d convince her parents to let her return to Lord Itsuki, but who knows how far she’ll go with that… Most likely, she left because she couldn’t understand Lord Itsuki’s sense of justice.”
So, the stalker pig didn’t come to Cal Mira Island after all. And now, Itsuki’s crew are kicking the wall in frustration.
“Damn it! We can’t do our menial tasks without her!”

I recall there’s a strict hierarchy among Itsuki’s crew. The guy who seems to be at the bottom of it is grumbling as he carries the luggage and follows me. For now, we’re boarding a ship to head to the hunting grounds.
“Move over!”
And for some reason, the guy carrying the luggage is being told by the others to move to the edge.
“Tch! If only Rishia were here, I wouldn’t have to go through this!”
He’s grumbling like that. Is there bullying going on here?

There’s absolutely no hope for them. They’re just a bunch of guys destined to end up as Smoked Meat, after all. They seem to be cut from the same cloth. And sure enough, the warrior—who appears to be second in the pecking order—is arrogantly taking up the most space. What a thoroughly unpleasant atmosphere.

As I boarded the ship, I found myself reminiscing about the days on Cal Mira Island with Filo-tan. Back when we were sailing across the sea with my Big Sister, watching the sunset, and Filo-tan was following right behind us like a waterbird… Why on earth did I say such cheesy lines to my Big Sister back then?
My Big Sister is just that—my Big Sister—and she can never be a romantic interest. Just like Father, she’s someone I’ve sworn my loyalty to.

Filo-tan… her feathers glistening in the sunset were so lustrous—what a captivating sight it was. Ah… Filo-tan. Splash! The guy at the very bottom of the pecking order just fell into the sea. I’m going to ignore him.
Well then, we’ve arrived at the island with the hunting grounds.
“Now then, my training will be rigorous! Don’t expect me to fight the same way as Itsuki—just follow my lead.”
“Spear Hero. At the very least, do something about how you address Lord Itsuki!”
This guy’s been noisy for a while now. I glare fiercely at the warrior who’s supposed to be second in the pecking order.
“What is it? Do you have some orders for me?”
“Calling Lord Itsuki by his first name alone is the height of rudeness! Just because the Shield Hero happened to be recognized, Spear Hero—that gives you no reason to act so high and mighty!”
“If you have a complaint, take it up with Itsuki. Though, he no longer has the authority to move about freely, of course.”
“Guh… You shameless villain!”
“Shut up! Just shut up and follow me. Otherwise, Itsuki’s standing will suffer.”
“Tch!”

Itsuki’s companions sure have a bad attitude. Come to think of it, it’s strange that the docile Stalker Pig actually seems decent by comparison. Come to think of it, the Stalker Pig was taken in by my Father, wasn’t he?
I remember seizing the opportunity to talk to the dejected Stalker Pig, and ultimately, my Father took him in and raised him. In other words, he was capable enough to earn my Father’s approval…

Hmm, I might need to revise my opinion a bit. Come to think of it, the Stalker Pig will be chosen as one of the Seven Star Heroes in the future. I’ve also heard that the Stalker Pig was the one keeping an eye on Itsuki to make sure he didn’t go off the rails. From that perspective, he might actually be better than the bunch here who’ll end up as Smoked Meat in the future.

Above all, I seem to recall that Filo-tan used to call him by his first name. I feel like I’ve seen them playing together—or maybe not. In any case, depending on the situation, there’s a possibility he’s actually human.
“Then, shall we proceed to learn the combat methods Lord Itsuki will teach us—”
“Ah, that won’t be necessary.”
I’ve seen it once before, after all. It’s not necessary. In short, these guys are just meat shields meant to draw aggro.
“But Lord Itsuki—”
“Forget that—just tell them to witness my strength firsthand so they’ll fully realize the gap in our abilities!”
I cut him off and said that. Itsuki’s companions immediately put on a displeased expression and started cursing.
“You’re getting way too cocky!”

They sure have no sense of restraint. Even though they lost to me head-on, do these guys even have a proper grasp of their opponent’s strength? I could take you all down with a single blow. Just as I was thinking that, another guy was causing a commotion.
“You! How dare you steal the monster we were about to defeat! You have no right to live—”
“Eek!?”

He’s acting all high and mighty after snatching the monster the adventurers were about to fight. In online gaming terms, that’s called “stealing a kill.” If it were my Father, he’d probably say that rules differ from game to game, but the only online game I know is Emerald Online. Well, I’m pretty sure we were warned about the exact same thing during the lecture on the island. Even so, these guys really don’t learn, do they?
“That’s disruptive behavior! Paralyze Lance!”
“Guh!”
I thrust my lance into him, and he collapsed with a thud.
